# Shorelife

> Shorelife (https://shorelifeca.org/) publishes free daily
> beach water quality ratings for monitored California beaches statewide.

Key facts:

- Coverage: statewide California, about 850 monitored beaches.
- Water quality rating: starts from the share of each beach's official
  enterococcus lab tests over the past 12 months that exceeded the safety
  limit, shrunk toward the statewide average. A logistic model, refit every
  morning on four years of lab results, adjusts that number for how far the
  latest result was above or below its limit, how recent it is, rain in the
  past 72 hours, and the season. The rating is never Low if the last test
  exceeded the safety limit, and it is raised to High while an official county
  advisory is active.
- Machine learning: a larger machine-learning model also trains daily as a
  challenger but does not set the served number. It serves only if it beats
  the rating on forward lab outcomes.
- Advisories take precedence: active county advisories and closures always override
  the rating.
- Decision support: ratings are decision support, not official lab results.

## Pages

- [Beach directory](https://shorelifeca.org/beaches/): all
  California beaches with today's risk band.
- [Conditions](https://shorelifeca.org/conditions/): coastal
  conditions, tides, water temperature, and surf context across California.
- [Methodology](https://shorelifeca.org/methodology/): how
  each beach's rating is computed and how county advisories override it.
- [Research](https://shorelifeca.org/research/): live accuracy
  metrics, calibration, risk bands, and data sources.
